metadata.citation: Li, M., Zhang, B., Li, L., Sun, T., & Brown, A. (2025). Mixed-Keying or Desirability-Matching in the Construction of Forced-Choice Measures? An Empirical Investigation and Practical Recommendations. Organizational Research Methods, 28(2), 296–329.
metadata.preparation: Apply the authors' quality-screening rules, deduplicate source respondents, retain complete FC3 first-occasion responses, and sample 200 respondents without replacement using pandas. Assign sequential respondent IDs. Match the independent desirability ratings to the original item IDs and keep only numerical design, responses and desirability.
